units: pixels, frames, seconds; image x to the right, y downward
background: uniform light grey (RGB 206,206,206); no ground, no markings, no other objects

camera.motion: static (background uniform, no shift measurable; both objects move at constant per-frame steps)
camera.perspective: none visible; 2D scene, motion in a plane facing the camera

virus_small_left.description: smaller spiky virus particle (dark-blue spherical body, ~40 dark-red club-tipped spikes); starts on the LEFT of the pair
virus_small_left.reference_point: centre of the spherical body (least-squares circle fit), treated as the object origin

body_sphere_diameter_px.note: fit radius grows 121.9 -> 125.5 px as spikes/roots rotate; spikes not included

virus_small_left.motion: constant-velocity straight line to the LEFT (slightly downward): mean step dx = -14.17 px/frame (sd 0.20), dy = +0.14 px/frame, frames 1->40 body-fit
virus_small_left.rotation: slow rotation of spikes (template-match score falls 1.0 -> 0.72 by frame 32); outline nearly unchanged

virus_large_right.description: larger spiky virus particle (same look, ~1.12x larger); starts on the RIGHT of the pair
virus_large_right.reference_point: centre of the spherical body (least-squares circle fit), treated as the object origin

body_sphere_diameter_px.note: fit radius grows 137.7 -> 141.8 px with rotation

virus_large_right.motion: constant-velocity straight line to the RIGHT (slightly upward): mean step dx = +13.72 px/frame (sd 0.17), dy = -0.73 px/frame, frames 1->35 body-fit; step magnitude ~13.74 px/frame
virus_large_right.rotation: slow rotation of spikes (template score 1.0 -> 0.70 by frame 33)

pair_geometry.separation_change: objects move apart: horizontal separation grows ~27.9 px/frame; they never touch or overlap

events.event: motion starts for BOTH (first non-zero displacement, already at full constant step)
events.note: motion begins between frame 1 (t=0.0417) and frame 2

events.event: large: spike tips reach right image edge
small: spike tips reach left image edge
large: body sphere reaches right edge
small: body sphere reaches left edge
large: centre crosses right edge (x=1920); first frame with centre outside
small: centre crosses left edge (x=0); first frame with centre outside

no_events: no collision, bounce, contact, release or direction change; no acceleration measurable (per-frame steps constant within ~0.2 px)
